standing_on.geometry: digitised — NOAA ENC, cells US4CA1BX.000, US4CA74M.000, US5SANCD.000
standing_on.model: GFS-Wave, unassimilated; 0.9–1.0 ft (0.26–0.31 m) low bias at the buoy, not corrected here; its own directional spectrum, so no assumed spread
standing_on.seabed: MODELLED — refraction and shoaling over the USGS CoNED and GMRT seabed to 5 m of water off each break, the Coronado Islands by diffraction; linear, no breaking, unverified
standing_on.local chop: MODELLED — fetch-limited growth from the model's own wind, only over fetches closed by land
standing_on.calibration: none — nothing has been fitted to an observation; no offshore-to-face transfer, no band
standing_on.observation: none — data/beach_log/ is empty; nothing has measured these breaks
standing_on.claim: physically derived, not accurate; ordinal and differential, not a height at the beach

spread_assumption.note: not used — the model's directional spectrum carries its own spread
